commits_data.title: check_typed_item_calls.py: Add a check for all-zeroes mask
commits_data.message:
check_typed_item_calls.py: Add a check for all-zeroes mask

When the mask value is 0x0, it effectively means there is no
mask, and that all bits count.

Fix found instances and replace them with 0x0.
